description: Medscape eMedicine (Medscape Reference) clinical articles by specialty: title, topic category, article id and URL from the public specialty index, filtered by words in the title. With details=true the first 5 matches also get summary, author, last-reviewed date and paywall flag from the article page. Metadata only, no article text (Medscape articles need a free login). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

details.description: true = add summary, author and last-reviewed date for the first 5 results (default false)

q.description: Words that must all appear in the article title (optional, max 100 characters)
